Patient C3N-00953 has a GNN-A out-of-fold risk of 0.63 for stage III–IV ccRCC, driven entirely by tumor-protein features (tumor_share=1.0) [pred:C3N-00953:gnn]. The top tumor drivers are the strongly down‑regulated RALGAPA1 (z=−13.37) and the collagen hydroxylases P4HA2/P4HA1, together with the highly up‑regulated DPP9 (z=13.997) and serine dehydratase SDS [pt:C3N-00953:protein_down:NCBIGene:253959][pt:C3N-00953:protein_up:NCBIGene:91039][pt:C3N-00953:protein_up:NCBIGene:10993][contrib:C3N-00953:NCBIGene:253959][contrib:C3N-00953:NCBIGene:8974][contrib:C3N-00953:NCBIGene:10993][contrib:C3N-00953:NCBIGene:5033][contrib:C3N-00953:NCBIGene:91039]. - VHL mutation → loss of HIF degradation → P4HA2/P4HA1 up‑regulation (collagen hydroxylation) [E271418][E295721][E3831936].  
- BAP1 and DAXX mutations → chromatin/nucleosome dysregulation (DAXX–UBC interaction) [E319407][E3529974][E3597771].  
- RALGAPA1 loss (strongest down‑regulation) → Ral GTPase signaling alteration [contrib:C3N-00953:NCBIGene:253959].  
- DPP9 up‑regulation → protease/immune modulation (DPP9–UBC link) [E267735].  
- SDS up‑regulation → serine/glycine metabolism (SDS–pyridoxal phosphate binding) [E328728][E3507255].  
- Model-ranked metabolic genes (UROD, GSTM1, TST, MTHFD1, FPGS) connect to folate/heme/redox pathways [E55221][E54772][E3825624][E3809292].
